body:
## Summary

Refines the subgrid-scale (SGS) variance and covariance closure in `src/parameterized_tendencies/microphysics/cloud_fraction.jl` and updates its reference scale parameters against 4-season $0.25^\circ$ ERA5 + Germano isobaric subgrid cascade statistics across `1000–150 hPa`:

1. **Smooth harmonic buoyancy bound (`buoyancy_bounded_mixing_length`) with $\kappa_b = c_b \kappa_{\mathrm{iso}} / (2 c_\sigma)$**:
   $$l_{\mathrm{disp}} = \frac{l_{\mathrm{mix}}}{\sqrt{1 + \frac{2 c_\sigma \max(N_{\mathrm{disp}}^2, 0)\, l_{\mathrm{mix}}^2}{c_b \kappa_{\mathrm{iso}}}}}$$
   Replaces the hard `min` cap on the turbulent displacement length with a smooth harmonic transition using $\kappa_b = c_b \kappa_{\mathrm{iso}} / (2 c_\sigma)$ (matching the floor buoyancy scale $\kappa_{\min} = w_{\min}^2 / (2 c_\sigma c_b)$) and a `Float32`-safe continuity gate at $N_{\mathrm{disp}}^2 = 0$:
   - In neutral turbulent layers ($N_{\mathrm{disp}}^2 \le 0$), $l_{\mathrm{disp}} = l_{\mathrm{mix}}$ so the vertical displacement variance $\ell_{v,0}^2 = 2 c_\sigma l_d^2 = 2 c_\sigma l_{\mathrm{mix}}^2$ preserves the Sommeria–Mellor production–dissipation balance with `diagnostic_covariance_coeff` ($c_\sigma$) active.
   - In stably stratified layers and at sharp capping inversions ($2 c_\sigma N_{\mathrm{disp}}^2 l_{\mathrm{mix}}^2 \gg c_b \kappa_{\mathrm{iso}}$), $\ell_{v,0}^2 = 2 c_\sigma l_{\mathrm{disp}}^2 \to c_b \kappa_{\mathrm{iso}} / N_{\mathrm{disp}}^2$, smoothly bounding the vertical displacement variance by the exact adiabatic parcel excursion (eliminating the $2 c_\sigma \approx 3.8\times$ boundary-layer-top inversion spike on `main`), matching the floor variance $\ell_{v,\mathrm{floor}}^2 = w_{\min}^2 / N_{\mathrm{disp}}^2$ when $c_b \kappa_{\mathrm{iso}} = w_{\min}^2$, and giving $\tau_{\mathrm{turb}} = l_{\mathrm{disp}} / \sqrt{c_b \kappa_{\mathrm{iso}} / (2 c_\sigma)} \to 1 / N_{\mathrm{disp}}$.

2. **4-season $0.25^\circ$ ERA5 + Germano calibration (`1000–150 hPa`)**:
   | Parameter | Symbol | `main` | `ts/variance-updates` |
   | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
   | `sgs_variance_horizontal_scale_factor` | $c_{\Delta x}$ | `1.0` | `1.6` |
   | `sgs_variance_vertical_velocity_floor` | $w_{\mathrm{ref}}$ [m/s] | `1.6` | `1.3` |
   | `sgs_variance_floor_time_scale` | $\tau_0$ [s] | `300` | `180` |
   | `sgs_variance_theta_horizontal_scale_ratio` | $r_{\Delta x,\theta}$ | `0.7` | `0.75` |
   | `sgs_variance_theta_vertical_scale_ratio` | $r_{v,\theta}$ | `0.36` | `0.42` |
   | `sgs_variance_horizontal_cross_correlation` | $r_{h,\theta q}$ | `0.5` | `0.65` |

   *(In earlier 3.75 km MPAS free-troposphere snapshots, $1 / N_{\mathrm{disp}} < 300\text{ s}$ almost everywhere so those data only bounded $\tau_0$ from below; the 4-season $0.25^\circ$ ERA5 + Germano calibration across weakly stratified boundary layers (`1000–850 hPa`) constrains $\tau_0 = 180\text{ s}$ while the Germano cascade across $0.25^\circ \to 2.0^\circ$ accounts for the unresolved sub-$0.25^\circ$ tail.)*

## 4-Season $0.25^\circ$ ERA5 + Germano Isobaric Evaluation (`1000–150 hPa`)

![4-Season ERA5 + Germano Pressure-Coordinate Profiles (1000–150 hPa)](https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaAtmos.jl/blob/a11f4b6255c0d95d3e8ee0b3c7a713ec9484a3e3/variance_updates_era5_germano_pressure_profiles.png?raw=true)

| | $P(S > 0)$ [-] | `0.046` | `0.059` | `0.061` | `0.020` | `0.021` |

**MPAS Update (defaults recalibrated on the model grid).** The constants and ERA5+Germano tables are superseded. The defaults are fitted to 3.75 km MPAS (DYAMOND) within-cell moments mapped onto the model's cubed-sphere nodes, with every closure input computed by the model's own operators (spectral-element horizontal gradient, Van Leer ∂z, N²_disp, model TKE, this PR's harmonic bound) on MPAS native levels. The earlier offline fits used smoother horizontal gradients than the model computes, so they overestimated c_Δx (c_Δx 2.1 gave ~2× too much variance online).

| | c_Δx | w_ref | τ_0 | r_hθ | r_vθ | r_hθq |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| now | 1.24 | 1.08 | 300 | 0.88 | 0.38 | 0.74 |

One set fits ne16–ne60 and the 130- and 63-level grids. τ_0 isn't constrained by the data (≳ 100 s fits equally well), so it stays at 300 s.

**Online** (1M, 5-day forecast from 2020-01-01, ne30): the SGS spread matches MPAS to within ~10% (it was 1.4–1.6×). Headline-11 RMSE at days 3–5 is 10.9% lower than with the old parameters, and the harmonic bound contributes 2.4% of that (noise ±0.6%). Boundary-layer moisture improves most (q850 −6 to −7%). The cost is brighter clouds: reflected SW is ~4 W/m² higher than without the bound.

Also: c_Δx's code default overrides ClimaParams' 1.0 and is no longer logged as 1.0, and there's a new test through `materialized_displacement_length!`.
title: SGS variance: harmonic buoyancy bound; recalibrate defaults on the model grid

body: When `era5_initial_condition_dir` is unset and the wxquest_initial_conditions artifact has no file for the start date, fall back to the ClimaInitialConditions ERA5 cache and download from CDS instead of returning a missing path.
title: Fetch ERA5 IC when the artifact is missing the date

body:
Main saved a cache only when a key's dependency files changed, which happens rarely, so new dependency releases accumulated without new caches being built. Keys now end in the run ID. Each main build saves a new cache and deletes the older main caches for the same job, and PRs restore the newest one. The CI, Downstream, and Downgrade workflows get `actions: write` back so they can delete caches.

Unlike the default julia-actions/cache behavior, which saved a cache on every run on every branch, only main builds save caches here, so PRs restore the latest main cache without uploading their own.

Hopefully this will be the last cache-related PR.
title: Save a new Julia depot cache on every main build
